nodes.notes: Operator-only test entry. Configure an existing authorized test WhatsApp session before executing; never expose this path as a public webhook.

nodes.name: Sandbox Validate WhatsApp Checkout Input
nodes.notes: Reject empty, malformed, website-only, and non-WhatsApp checkout input before any Stripe request.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS payload
)
SELECT
  session.session_id,
  session.checkout_authorization_type,
  session.offer_version
FROM public.onboarding_sessions AS session
CROSS JOIN input
WHERE session.session_id = input.payload->>'session_id'
  AND session.checkout_authorized_at IS NOT NULL
  AND session.checkout_authorization_type IN ('explicit', 'contextual')
  AND session.offer_version = '28d-149-v1'
  AND session.checkout_session_id IS NULL;

nodes.name: Sandbox Verify Existing Checkout Authorization
nodes.notes: Read-only production-equivalent authorization gate. Missing authorization or an existing Checkout Session emits no item and cannot create a duplicate sandbox session.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS payload
),
website_user AS (
  UPDATE public.users AS target_user
  SET
    email = input.payload->>'email',
    is_active = TRUE,
    plan_type = '28_day_program',
    stripe_customer_id = COALESCE(
      NULLIF(input.payload->>'customer_id', ''),
      target_user.stripe_customer_id
    )
  FROM input
  WHERE input.payload->>'acquisition_source' = 'website'
    AND target_user.id = NULLIF(input.payload->>'user_id', '')::uuid
    AND target_user.whatsapp_id IS NULL
    AND NULLIF(target_user.portal_token, '') IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING target_user.*
),
whatsapp_user AS (
  INSERT INTO public.users AS target_user (
    whatsapp_id,
    email,
    is_active,
    plan_type,
    stripe_customer_id
  )
  SELECT
    payload->>'whatsapp_id',
    payload->>'email',
    TRUE,
    '28_day_program',
    NULLIF(payload->>'customer_id', '')
  FROM input
  WHERE input.payload->>'acquisition_source' = 'whatsapp'
    AND NULLIF(input.payload->>'whatsapp_id', '') IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (whatsapp_id) DO UPDATE
    SET whatsapp_id = EXCLUDED.whatsapp_id,
        email = EXCLUDED.email
  RETURNING target_user.*
),
resolved_user AS (
  SELECT * FROM website_user
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM whatsapp_user
),
user_resolution_assertion AS (
  SELECT 1 / COUNT(*)::integer AS resolution_valid
  FROM resolved_user
),
resolved_purchase AS (
  INSERT INTO public.purchases AS target_purchase (
    user_id,
    program_id,
    stripe_checkout_session_id,
    stripe_payment_intent_id,
    stripe_customer_id,
    stripe_product_id,
    stripe_price_id,
    purchase_type,
    payment_status,
    amount_total,
    currency,
    purchased_at
  )
  SELECT
    resolved_user.id,
    NULL,
    input.payload->>'checkout_session_id',
    input.payload->>'payment_intent_id',
    NULLIF(input.payload->>'customer_id', ''),
    NULLIF(input.payload->>'verified_product_id', ''),
    NULLIF(input.payload->>'verified_price_id', ''),
    '28_day_program',
    'paid',
    14900,
    'mxn',
    (input.payload->>'purchased_at')::timestamptz
  FROM input
  CROSS JOIN resolved_user
  CROSS JOIN user_resolution_assertion
  WHERE user_resolution_assertion.resolution_valid = 1
  ON CONFLICT (stripe_checkout_session_id) DO UPDATE
    SET stripe_checkout_session_id = EXCLUDED.stripe_checkout_session_id
  RETURNING target_purchase.*, (target_purchase.xmax = 0) AS purchase_created
), linked_messages AS (
  UPDATE public.messages AS message
  SET user_id = resolved_user.id
  FROM resolved_user, input
  WHERE message.session_id = input.payload->>'whatsapp_id'
    AND message.user_id IS NULL
  RETURNING message.id
), linked_funnel AS (
  UPDATE public.sales_funnel_events AS event
  SET user_id = resolved_user.id
  FROM resolved_user, input
  WHERE event.session_id = input.payload->>'whatsapp_id'
    AND event.user_id IS NULL
  RETURNING event.id
), purchase_event AS (
  INSERT INTO public.sales_funnel_events (
    session_id, user_id, event_type, event_key, offer_version, metadata
  )
  SELECT
    input.payload->>'whatsapp_id', resolved_user.id,
    'purchase_completed',
    'purchase_completed:' || resolved_purchase.stripe_checkout_session_id,
    '28d-149-v1',
    jsonb_build_object('checkout_session_id', resolved_purchase.stripe_checkout_session_id) ||
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('offer_context', (
      SELECT offer_context FROM public.onboarding_sessions
      WHERE session_id = input.payload->>'whatsapp_id'
    )))
  FROM input CROSS JOIN resolved_user CROSS JOIN resolved_purchase
  WHERE resolved_purchase.payment_status = 'paid'
  ON CONFLICT (event_key) WHERE event_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
)
SELECT
  resolved_user.id AS user_id,
  resolved_user.whatsapp_id,
  resolved_user.portal_token,
  resolved_purchase.id AS purchase_id,
  resolved_purchase.stripe_checkout_session_id,
  resolved_purchase.purchase_created
FROM user_resolution_assertion
LEFT JOIN resolved_user ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN resolved_purchase ON TRUE
WHERE user_resolution_assertion.resolution_valid = 1;

nodes.name: Sandbox Resolve User and Persist Purchase

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS payload
),
updated_session AS (
  UPDATE public.onboarding_sessions AS target_session
  SET
    conversation_stage = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM input
  WHERE target_session.session_id = input.payload->>'whatsapp_id'
  RETURNING target_session.session_id
)
SELECT
  input.payload->>'user_id' AS user_id,
  input.payload->>'whatsapp_id' AS whatsapp_id,
  input.payload->>'portal_token' AS portal_token,
  input.payload->>'purchase_id' AS purchase_id,
  input.payload->>'stripe_checkout_session_id' AS stripe_checkout_session_id,
  (input.payload->>'purchase_created')::boolean AS purchase_created,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated_session) AS onboarding_session_updated
FROM input;

nodes.name: Sandbox If Customer Has WhatsApp
nodes.notes: Website purchasers receive Setup access through the verified Checkout success redirect; never reserve or send Twilio messages without a real WhatsApp channel.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS payload), reserved AS (
  INSERT INTO public.messages (
    user_id, session_id, direction, body, message_kind, provider,
    idempotency_key, in_reply_to_id, delivery_status, metadata,
    assistant_response
  )
  SELECT
    NULLIF(input.payload->>'user_id', '')::uuid,
    input.payload->>'session_id', 'outbound', input.payload->>'body',
    input.payload->>'message_kind', 'twilio', input.payload->>'idempotency_key',
    NULLIF(input.payload->>'in_reply_to_id', '')::uuid, 'pending',
    COALESCE(input.payload->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb), input.payload->>'body'
  FROM input
  WHERE NULLIF(input.payload->>'body', '') IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT * FROM reserved;

nodes.name: Sandbox Reserve Setup Link
nodes.notes: Only the execution that inserts this unique logical reservation may call Twilio.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS payload), classified AS (
  SELECT
    payload,
    CASE
      WHEN payload->>'error_code' = '21617'
        OR LOWER(COALESCE(payload->>'provider_status', '')) IN ('canceled', 'failed', 'undelivered')
        OR COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'status_code', '')::integer, 0) BETWEEN 400 AND 499
        THEN 'failed'
      WHEN payload->>'expected_status' = 'scheduled'
        AND LOWER(COALESCE(payload->>'provider_status', '')) = 'scheduled'
        AND payload->>'provider_message_sid' ~ '^(SM|MM)[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$'
        THEN 'scheduled'
      WHEN payload->>'expected_status' = 'accepted'
        AND payload->>'provider_message_sid' ~ '^(SM|MM)[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$'
        THEN 'accepted'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS final_status
  FROM input
), updated AS (
  UPDATE public.messages AS message
  SET provider_message_sid = CASE
        WHEN classified.payload->>'provider_message_sid' ~ '^(SM|MM)[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$'
          THEN classified.payload->>'provider_message_sid'
        ELSE message.provider_message_sid
      END,
      delivery_status = classified.final_status,
      metadata = message.metadata || jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'provider_status', NULLIF(classified.payload->>'provider_status', ''),
        'provider_error_code', NULLIF(classified.payload->>'error_code', ''),
        'provider_error_message', LEFT(NULLIF(classified.payload->>'error_message', ''), 300),
        'provider_acceptance_evidence', CASE
          WHEN classified.final_status IN ('accepted', 'scheduled') THEN 'message_sid'
          WHEN classified.final_status = 'failed' THEN 'definitive_failure'
          ELSE 'reconciliation_required'
        END
      ))
  FROM classified
  WHERE message.idempotency_key = classified.payload->>'idempotency_key'
    AND message.delivery_status = 'pending'
  RETURNING message.*
)
SELECT * FROM updated;
